enchantment.wenxingtools.life_amplificat: Reduces incoming damage by a multiplier.
enchantment.wenxingtools.attack_amplific: Deals true damage equal to a percentage of the target's max health and heals you.
enchantment.wenxingtools.resource_amplif: Drops extra items and XP by a multiplier; toggle with Numpad 0 (configurable)
enchantment.wenxingtools.potion_amplific: Extends the duration of existing positive potion effects and continuously clears your own negative effects.
enchantment.wenxingtools.spawn_egg_harve: Drops corresponding spawn eggs; mobs without a native spawn egg drop WenXing Spawn Eggs. Ignores Resource Amplification and Looting.
enchantment.wenxingtools.echo_amplificat: After a hit, deals 10×level void damage hits.
item.wenxingtools.wenxing_torch.desc: Prevents mobs from spawning in a 3x3-chunk area by default; right-click with the Wenxing Pickaxe to change the range
item.wenxingtools.wenxing_platform.desc: Builds a 3x3-chunk platform by default; right-click with the Wenxing Pickaxe to change the size, sneak + right-click to build centered on the player; note: the build destroys blocks up to 16 blocks above the platform
item.wenxingtools.generic_spawn_egg.spaw: Right-click ground to spawn the mob; right-click a spawner to set its type
